title: moosaic — Package Specification
text: Read data_format = "long", format_out = "matrix" (smallest memory; data.frame/data.table also possible). FID read scale = TRUE (chromConverter default: applies file’s scaling factor; intensity_multiplier informational ). Consequences design: - ~14 FID points per MS scan → FID must resampled onto MS scan grid C0 (boxcar mean scan interval, point interpolation, avoid aliasing narrow peaks). - m/z fractional → nominal binning uses round(mz) (centre integers, 39.9 → 40); mz_bin stays option. - Whole-run dense D ≈ 21,119 × 466 doubles ≈ 79 MB: acceptable, store whole run sparse dgCMatrix; densify per window . - supplied TIC used directly alignment (need rebuild); .build_tic() remains fallback/check. - Metadata pulled attributes metadata lists.

text: Whitespace-delimited, header, one alkane per line: rt  RI  col3  col4  name, e.g. 5.850 800.0 100 100 Octane. Columns 3–4 (100 100) carried col3/col4 (meaning confirm; likely ChemStation response fields, unused). name may contain spaces → parse first four tokens numeric join remainder name. General requirements (calibration files vary users): - Reference compounds arbitrary: n-alkanes, aromatics (benzene, toluene, naphthalene), alkylcyclohexanes, polycyclics, etc. RI values need multiples 100 evenly spaced. assumptions carbon number, compound class, count. - .compute_ri() uses (rt, RI) pairs, piecewise linear interpolation neighbouring references: RI=RIi+(RIi+1−RIi)t−titi+1−tiRI = RI_i + (RI_{+1} - RI_i)\,\frac{t - t_i}{t_{+1} - t_i} - rt outside calibrated range → RI NA + warning (option moosaic.ri_extrapolate = FALSE; TRUE, linear two nearest points). - ONSITE.CAL used format/parsing fixture, define expected chemistry. - file lives workspace root now; copy tests/testthat/fixtures/ri/ONSITE.CAL fixture add .Rbuildignore. Validation read_ri_calibration(): ≥ 2 rows; rt strictly increasing; RI strictly increasing; numeric parse failures abort line number.
